Synopsis:
CINE ARTIST - PLEASE CONTACT WRITER! (RUAIRI)The flow looks complex due to integration of an OM, but is relatively simple after the first stage.The first stage is always Nine-Fingers arguing with her underling Uktar, who always leaves before the first player QNs.After that, Jaheira's OM is prioritised, where Nine-Fingers tells her that Minsc is the Stone Lord. The Guild have set a trap to kill him, and she doesn't want Jaheira to interfere.After that, Nine-Fingers introduces herself to the player and can be asked questions about the city. If Jaheira's OM has not triggered yet, that takes priority on any subsequent meetings.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_Guildhall_NineFingers.json: The scene takes place in Nine‑Fingers Keene’s Guildhall just after she’s finished a private argument with her underling Uktar — Uktar departs before the player's questions, so only Nine‑Fingers and Jaheira remain on‑screen. Nine‑Fingers immediately prioritises Jaheira’s quest objective: she tells Jaheira (whom she sometimes calls Astele) that Minsc has embraced the Absolute and now goes by the title “Stone Lord,” and coldly reveals the Guild has set a trap to kill him and will not tolerate Jaheira’s interference. After that confrontation Nine‑Fingers turns to the player, introduces herself and can be asked routine questions about the city; if Jaheira’s objective hasn’t yet fired, it will take precedence in future meetings. (Separately, the player may have opportunities elsewhere to find or speak with Minsc after the cult fight and to seek protection for him from the Emperor.)
- LOW_Guildhall_Ninefingers_OM_Minsc_COM_OOM.json: Note: OOM is moved to separate dialogMinsc confronts Nine-Fingers after their temporary truce until the Zhent were defeated. He means to kill her, but she tries to convince him that the Guild is ultimately a force for good within the city.
- LOW_Guildhall_Ninefingers_OM_Minsc_OOM.json: Minsc confronts Nine-Fingers after their temporary truce until the Zhent were defeated. He means to kill her, but she tries to convince him that the Guild is ultimately a force for good within the city.

- LOW_Guildhall_NineFingers_OM_Minsc_DuringCoup_OOM.json: Quick and short origin moment between Minsc and Nine-Fingers (Jaheira optional). The Zhent have just turned on the Guild, and Minsc and player must choose whether to help Nine-Fingers or not.

context: The scene is in Nine‑Fingers Keene’s guildhall just after she finished a private argument with her underling Uktar, who left before the player arrived — only Nine‑Fingers and Jaheira remain on‑screen. Nine‑Fingers immediately prioritises Jaheira’s quest: she tells Jaheira that Minsc has embraced the Absolute and now styles himself the “Stone Lord,” and that the Guild has set a trap to kill him. She makes plain she will not tolerate Jaheira’s interference and even suggests she won’t fuss over the condition of his corpse, provoking Jaheira’s anger and a personal appeal using the name “Astele.” After that confrontation Nine‑Fingers turns to the player, introduces herself, and can be asked routine questions about the city, though Jaheira’s objective will take precedence in later meetings.
